notes.title: Three new voice-overs added.
notes.content:
Three new voice-overs have been added: 


ENGLISH male (replacing the old version with a more empathetic one)
ENGLISH female 
GERMAN male

notes.title: Home-Screen Fix
notes.content: Fixed: Home-Screen loop was not displaying for users without the Windows HEVC (H265) Extension. Now H264-based, same as the default main content file.

notes.title: German Voice-Over Added
notes.content:
Conscious Existence now has a German female voice-over, as well as an additional option to auto-load saved settings at startup.

Full Changelog

- German Voice Over Integration
- Added: option to auto-load saved settings on app-start
- Fixed: bug with a hand pose not working correctly
- Fixed: bug with correctly loading the user-saved sampling resolution
- Fixed: download progress bar was not updating when app paused
- Added note that headset can be removed while downloading

notes.title: FIXED - Controller Issues
notes.content:
Controller issues which were introduced with recent SteamVR updates have now been fixed,  it should work fine again with all headsets and controllers.
 Keyboard shortcuts as fallback solution have been made more obvious directly in the UI.

notes.title: Index Support and Keyboard Shortcuts Added
notes.content:
App now also works on the Index VR Headset

 Added Keyboard Shortcuts: Play/Pause - Space; R - Reset View; L - Toggle Voice-Over. 
Make sure the app window is in focus for those to work.

notes.title: NOW UPDATED || Toggle Voice // Reset View // Black Levels
notes.content:
You can now turn off the girl's voice-over using your Vive/Touch controllers if you wish.
 View can be re-oriented horizontally as well as vertically if you like, so you may also lie down while watching. 
 Black Levels have been reduced (= more perceived contrast) to a point that is more pleasant to the eyes, as much as it was possible without introducing any artifacts.


Hope you enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

P.S: I'm planning to add the WIN7/8 compatible version with a bit reduced resolution as DLC package, so not everyone has to download an extra 10GB. Coming soon - but until then just shoot me an e-mail after purchase and I'll set you up (address see support contact info).

notes.title: Update to Toggle Voice Over
notes.content:
As this was requested a couple of times there will soon be an update with a switch to toggle the voice over on/off as well as probably a re-center button. 
I'm planning to release the update by the end of June latest.
